set.body: PyMVPA PDistTargetSimilarity is numerically reproducible from MeasuredObservationRdm, but ScalaFIM exposes no first-class observation-RDM model query. Decide whether this belongs as a typed observation estimand, should require explicit promotion to relational evidence, or remains downstream. Acceptance: one ownership decision, laws, and documentation; no ad-hoc generic scorer.
set.title: Decide ownership of observation-RDM model comparison
